requirements.title: Disciplinary or project alternative
requirements.summary: The department lists AI applications in civil, biomedical, mechanical, electrical/computer engineering and construction management without specific course codes. A hands-on AI project course requires prior AI Minor Committee approval.

requirements.title: Catalog admission course
requirements.summary: The catalog requires prior completion of IDC 2002 (AI for all).

requirements.title: Catalog programming prerequisite
requirements.summary: Complete a Python programming course offered by ECE or the Knight Foundation School of Computing and Information Sciences; no course code is specified.

requirements.title: Department admission conditions
requirements.summary: The department lists minimum GPA 3.0, availability to all engineering and computing students in spring and fall, Python programming and math/statistics knowledge. Work with the current advisor to request admission.

requirements.title: Twelve-credit minor
requirements.summary: The minor comprises nine core credits and one three-credit elective. Admission/preparation courses are separate conditions; they are not silently included in the twelve credits.

requirements.title: Unresolved machine-learning option
requirements.summary: The catalog lists CAI 4105; the current department page instead lists CAP 4612. Their equivalence or substitution authority has not been verified. This record uses the catalog choice and preserves CAP 4612 as a conflicting department observation, not an additional approved option.

requirements.title: Minor declaration and approval
requirements.summary: An academic advisor must initiate declaration through the electronic Change of Program Plan process; the appropriate academic unit must approve it. Plan with the advisor to avoid extending graduation.

requirements.title: Changes after 90 credit hours
requirements.summary: After 90 earned credit hours, adding/changing a minor requires College Dean approval when it extends degree completion or results in excess credit hours.

requirements.title: Minor awarded with bachelor’s degree
requirements.summary: The minor is awarded upon completion of the bachelor’s degree and recorded in the transcript degree comment; this does not establish permission to complete it as a standalone post-degree credential.

notes: Credit amounts are published as credits, with normalized unit unverified.
